role: Regierungspräsident (President of the cantonal government), head of the Präsidialdepartement
description: Elected Regierungspräsident in the 2024 by-election (second round, 7 April 2024) and confirmed at the October 2024 general elections. Heads the Präsidialdepartement, whose dossiers include culture, housing/housing protection (Wohnschutz), climate strategy and major events; oversaw Basel as host city of the Eurovision Song Contest 2025.

role: Regierungsrat, Vorsteher des Erziehungsdepartements (Minister of Education)
description: Member of the cantonal government from 8 February 2017; headed the education department (Erziehungsdepartement) until taking over the Präsidialdepartement as government president in 2024. Major files included the integrative school and the Foerderklassen counter-proposal, school camps and safeguarding at the canton's ballet/dance schools.
Worked full-time as a lawyer from 2007 and as a public notary from 2009 at the law firm VISCHER until taking office as a member of the cantonal government.

role: Lehrbeauftragter (lecturer) for private law, with focus on company and contract law
organization: University of Basel, Faculty of Law
description: Held a teaching position for private law (Privatrecht) at the University of Basel; in December 2017 completed his habilitation and received the venia docendi and the title of Privatdozent.

role: Mitglied des Grossen Rates (member of the cantonal parliament); President 2013/2014
description: Member of the cantonal parliament of Basel-Stadt. President of the Grosser Rat for the 2013/2014 term (elected 6 February 2013, then the youngest Grand Council president in about a century). Member of the parliament's Buero (executive committee) 2009-2014 and president of the planning/building commission (Bau- und Raumplanungskommission) 2014-2016.
Member of the municipal council of Riehen.

role: Praesident der Jungliberalen Basel (President of the Young Liberals)
description: President of the Young Liberal Party of Basel.
